name: issuethroughput

queries.label: main
queries.sql_text:
SELECT
    i.id,
    i.original_project,
    i.created_date,
    i.resolution_date,
    i.status,
    i.issue_key,
    i.url,
    i.type,
    i.component,
    i.assignee_name,
    i.creator_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT il.label_name) AS labels
FROM devlake.issues i
LEFT JOIN devlake.issue_labels il ON il.issue_id = i.id
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM devlake.board_issues scoped_board WHERE scoped_board.issue_id = i.id AND scoped_board.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(:boardScopes, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
      project_key VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_key',
      project_name VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_name',
      board_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.board_id',
      connection_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.connection_id'
    )) AS selected_scope
    WHERE ((selected_scope.project_key <> '' AND selected_scope.project_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.issue_key, '-', 1))
      OR (selected_scope.project_name <> '' AND selected_scope.project_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = i.original_project))
      AND (selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', -1))
      AND (selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1))
  ))
  AND (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND (i.original_project IN (:projectNames) OR SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.issue_key, '-', 1) IN (:projectKeys)))
  AND (:excludeCount = 0 OR i.original_project NOT IN (:excludeProjects))
  AND (:hasUserwhitelist = 0 OR i.assignee_name IN (:userwhitelist))
  AND ((:hasFrom = 0 AND :hasTo = 0)
       OR i.status IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS')
       OR ((:hasFrom = 0 OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) >= :from)
           AND (:hasTo = 0 OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) <= :to)))
GROUP BY i.id, i.original_project, i.created_date, i.resolution_date, i.status,
         i.issue_key, i.url, i.type, i.component, i.assignee_name, i.creator_name
